title: North Korea drone production expansion at Kusong — satellite analysis
snippet: Korea Herald — Satellite imagery analysis shows expansion of drone production facilities at Kusong, North Korea. New buildings and infrastructure visible at known military-industrial complex. Assessed as part of DPRK unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) buildup program.
tag_reason: New event; satellite-observed military production expansion in DPRK Kusong area.
